description: Manual log of recurring task patterns. Review when count >= threshold to decide if a new skill is needed.

how_to_use.when_to_add: After completing a task that felt repetitive or follows a pattern you've done before
how_to_use.when_to_review: Periodically, or when a pattern hits the threshold count
how_to_use.action_at_threshold: Create a new skill in .claude/skills/[pattern-name]/SKILL.md, add to CLAUDE.md skills table
how_to_use.format: Each pattern has a name, description, count, and first_seen date
